method: Full reread of saved revised items including every option, key, rationale and metadata; reasoned through the case discriminator and the previously reported issue. Previously passed included items were also reread; no automated editorial acceptance.
limitations: Not external clinician or psychometric validation
Source verification is targeted; prior reports document checks and newly supplied author references are not presumed independently verified.
